name: AIMS Method

full_text: Identify the problem and set clear objectives. Gather relevant data and analyze it systematically. Develop multiple solutions and evaluate them against the objectives. Select the best solution and implement it, monitoring the results for effectiveness.

name: Matrix Method

name: CRISP-DM
description: A structured framework for data mining projects with phases and tasks.
full_text: Begin by understanding the business objectives and success criteria. Collect and describe initial data, ensuring data quality. Prepare data by cleaning, constructing, integrating, and formatting it. Select modeling techniques and build models, assessing their performance. Evaluate results against business success criteria and plan deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. Document the entire process and review project experience.
checkpoints: includes phases: Business Understanding, Data Understanding, Data Preparation, Modeling, Evaluation, Deployment
lists outputs for each phase, such as 'Data Description Report' and 'Model Assessment'
contains a project plan with initial assessment of tools and techniques
documents review of process and project experience

name: Assess Situation
description: Evaluate the current context and conditions affecting the data mining project.
full_text: Query relevant data sources to gather information about the current situation. Identify key factors and constraints impacting the project. Analyze the context to understand the environment in which the data mining will occur. Document findings to inform subsequent steps.
checkpoints: identifies key factors impacting the project
provides context for the data mining environment

name: Determine Data Mining Goals
description: Define specific objectives and desired outcomes for the data mining project.
full_text: Decompose the project into specific goals by querying stakeholders and reviewing project requirements. Establish clear, measurable objectives that the data mining process should achieve. Ensure alignment with broader business or research goals. Document these goals for reference throughout the project.
checkpoints: lists specific objectives for the project
aligns goals with broader business or research aims
documents measurable outcomes for data mining

name: Project Planning
description: Outline steps to achieve data mining and business goals.
full_text: Query the data sources to produce a project plan that outlines steps to achieve data mining and business goals. Specify stages, tools, and techniques to be used. Ensure the plan is comprehensive and actionable.

name: Collect Initial Data
description: Gather relevant data from various sources to begin the data mining process.
full_text: Identify and query data sources to collect initial datasets. Ensure data is relevant and sufficient for the project's goals. Document the sources and types of data collected. Verify the completeness and accuracy of the data before proceeding.
checkpoints: documents sources and types of data collected
verifies completeness and accuracy of data
ensures data relevance to project goals

name: Data Description
description: Examine and report on the surface properties of acquired data.
full_text: Query the data source to identify the format, quantity, and identities of fields. Evaluate whether the data meets relevant requirements. Compile findings into a data description report, detailing surface features and any discrepancies.
checkpoints: includes format and quantity of data

name: Data Exploration
description: Address data mining questions using querying, visualization, and reporting techniques.
full_text: Query the data to analyze distributions, relationships, and aggregations. Use visualization tools to identify significant sub-populations and perform simple statistical analyses. Document initial findings and hypotheses in a data exploration report, including graphs and plots.
checkpoints: includes distribution analysis of key attributes

name: Data Quality Verification
description: Examine the completeness and correctness of the data, identifying errors and missing values.
full_text: Query the data to assess completeness and correctness. Identify errors and missing values, noting their frequency and representation. Compile a data quality report listing verification results and potential solutions, leveraging both data and business knowledge.
checkpoints: lists completeness and correctness of data

name: Data Selection
description: Decide on data for analysis based on relevance, quality, and technical constraints.
full_text: Query the dataset to identify attributes and records relevant to the data mining goals. Evaluate the quality and technical constraints such as data volume and types. Decide on inclusion or exclusion of data based on these criteria and document the rationale for each decision.
checkpoints: considers relevance to data mining goals

name: Data Cleaning
description: Improve data quality to meet analysis technique requirements.
full_text: Identify data quality issues reported during the Verify Data Quality task. Apply cleaning techniques such as selecting clean subsets, inserting defaults, or estimating missing data. Document the decisions and actions taken, including transformations and their potential impact on analysis results.
checkpoints: describes actions taken to address data quality
considers impact of cleaning on analysis results

name: Data Construction
description: Create derived attributes or new records for data preparation.
full_text: Identify opportunities to construct new attributes from existing ones or generate new records. Perform operations such as deriving attributes or transforming values. Document the creation of derived attributes and generated records, explaining their relevance to the analysis.

name: Data Integration
description: Combine information from multiple tables or records to create new records or values.
full_text: Identify tables or records with complementary information about the same objects. Perform merging operations to join these tables, creating new records with combined fields. Consider aggregation operations to summarize information from multiple sources. Document the merged data and any aggregations performed.
checkpoints: documents new records with combined fields

name: Data Formatting
description: Apply syntactic modifications to data without changing its meaning.
full_text: Identify the syntactic requirements of the modeling tool. Modify the dataset to meet these requirements, such as reordering fields or removing unwanted characters. Ensure the data format aligns with the tool's specifications.

name: Select Modeling Technique
description: Choose appropriate modeling methods for data analysis.
full_text: Query project goals and data characteristics to select suitable modeling techniques. Evaluate different methods for their applicability and effectiveness. Document the selection process and rationale for chosen techniques. Ensure selected techniques align with project objectives.

name: Generate Test Design
description: Create a plan for testing the model's performance.
full_text: Query data and modeling requirements to design tests for model evaluation. Define metrics and criteria for assessing model performance. Document the test design and expected outcomes. Ensure tests are comprehensive and aligned with project goals.
checkpoints: documents test design and expected outcomes

name: Build Model
description: Develop a model based on selected techniques and data.
full_text: Query data and apply selected modeling techniques to build the model. Implement algorithms and processes to develop the model structure. Document the building process and any challenges faced. Ensure the model is robust and ready for testing.

name: Model Assessment
description: Evaluate and rank models based on quality and business objectives.
full_text: Interpret the models using domain knowledge and evaluation criteria. Rank the models according to their quality, considering both technical success and business objectives. Compare results from different techniques and revise parameter settings based on assessment outcomes. Document the qualities of each model and iterate until optimal results are achieved.
checkpoints: documents model qualities and assessment outcomes

name: CRISP-DM Methodology
description: A structured approach to data mining projects with phases, tasks, and process instances.
full_text: Identify the phases of the data mining project. Break down each phase into generic and specialized tasks. Record actions, decisions, and results as process instances. Use the reference model for an overview and the user guide for detailed execution tips.

records actions, decisions, and results as process instances
uses both reference model and user guide

name: Data Mining Context Mapping

checkpoints: identifies application domain, problem type, technical aspect, and tool/technique dimensions

name: CRISP-DM Mapping
description: Maps generic process models to specialized contexts in data mining projects.
full_text: Analyze your specific data mining context by identifying fixed dimensions. Remove irrelevant details and add context-specific information. Specialize generic contents according to the concrete characteristics of your context. Rename generic contents for clarity. Ensure the mapping aligns with the needs of your organization.

name: CRISP-DM Process Model
description: Provides an overview of the life cycle of a data mining project.
full_text: Begin by identifying the six phases of the CRISP-DM process model. Query data sources to understand the sequence and dependencies between these phases.
